profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at MetroStar
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced full-stack web developer, most notably in Ruby on Rails and Java/SpringBoot for the backend, as well as React for the frontend. Additionally, I have led development teams, providing technical guidance and support in order to fulfil project deliverables in a timely and quality manner. I am accustomed to adapting to new systems on the fly, and I am a huge team player with strong communication skills and an eagerness to share my ideas and collaborate with others.

My goal is to utilize my development skills to build, improve and maintain your application in order to create a positive user experience beneficial for everyone.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Using Python for both frontend and backend, actively worked on modernizing how the application was maintained - introduced a system of source-controlling our database data using JSON configurations and using 'visitor pattern' concept for doing work with that data
- Collaborated with Design, QA, and Project Owners to implement solutions based on detailed design and business requirements
- Engaged in both solo and paired programming, as well as actively reviewed other developers work to promote high quality code and consistency
- Performed thorough end-to-end testing of new features in order to ensure positive user experience and feedback
- Utilized internal AI tooling to help streamline both analysis of legacy code and the development of newer code

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Coordinate and supervise development work to ensure quality completion of project deliverables in a timely manner.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to developers, while ensuring adherence to established coding standards.
• Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Business Analysists, Designers, Product Owners and other stakeholders to identify actionable tasks, and provide technical knowledge and support.
• Serve as the bridge between the engineering team and client, establishing trust, clarity, and confidence through effective communication.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Using React for the frontend and Ruby on Rails for the backend, actively worked on a project consisting of many repositories to translate business requirements into actionable solutions
- Collaborate with Design, QA, Project Owners, and even external teams/systems to implement solutions based on detailed design and business requirements 
- Engaged in both solo and paired programming, as well as actively reviewed other developers' work from internal and external teams, in order to promote high quality code and consistency 
- Performed thorough end-to-end testing of new features in order to ensure positive user experience and feedback

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
• Trained in Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, Typescript, Angular, React & Selenium languages/frameworks
• Implemented object-oriented programming and MVC concepts when designing/building service-based business applications
• Performed thorough quality assurance testing on application UI's in order to ensure positive user experience
• Tested often on languages/frameworks and best coding practices through online, internal certifications

projects.title: Chow List
projects.description:
Bucket-list app for traveling foodies where a user can look up a specific location they plan on traveling to, get back results for popular restaurants in that area, add them to a personal bucket-list and leave reviews based on your experience. This app was built entirely on my own using Ruby on Rails for the back end and React.js for the front end.

Video Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8FCx-mZHHms&ab_channel=LucioGonzalez
Github Backend: https://github.com/lgonzalez2/Chow_List-BackEnd
Github Frontend: https://github.com/lgonzalez2/Chow_List-FrontEnd

projects.title: Vibe Wave
projects.description:
Youtube video-sharing app where users can post their favorite songs and leave likes and comments on all posts within the community. This app was built using Ruby on Rails for the back end and simple Javascript for the front end, in collaboration with fellow Flatiron student, Tomas Gonzalez.

Video Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RhngjeCWpDY&ab_channel=TomasGonzalez
